# chameleon_principal_role_assignment (Data Source)

List all principal roles assigned to a Polaris principal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "chameleon_principal_role_assignment" "etl_roles" {
  principal = "etl-pipeline"
}

output "etl_assigned_roles" {
  value = data.chameleon_principal_role_assignment.etl_roles.roles
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `roles` (List of String)
